_note: Machine-readable copy of story/bible.md section 5. tools/art reads this file first. Keep it in sync with the bible.
style: Modern full-colour vertical webtoon style, clean digital linework with soft cel shading, cinematic framing, expressive faces. Palette: warm paper cream, ink black, ash grey, ochre/brass lamp light, cold teal reserved for the Silent, and vermilion reserved only for word power. No purple, no violet, no blue neon

characters.dan: 24-year-old East-Slavic man, 178 cm, lean and slightly hunched, tired but kind face, short messy black hair with a cowlick, dark brown eyes with faint dark circles, round black-frame glasses with a bit of tape on the hinge, light stubble. Rumpled pale-grey button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, loosened dark-olive chinos, white sneakers, a mustard-yellow office lanyard around his neck, a yellow carpenter pencil behind his right ear
characters.mira: 23-year-old woman, 168 cm, athletic and wiry, sharp narrow face, olive-tan skin, amber-gold eyes, small scar through her left eyebrow, dark-brown choppy shoulder-length hair tied in a short ponytail with loose strands. Olive-khaki canvas climbing jacket with patched elbows, long cream scarf, black fingerless gloves, ink-black cargo trousers, rust-brown boots, a worn canvas backpack with a coil of rope, a frayed vermilion cord bracelet on her left wrist. Default expression: dry, unimpressed, half-lidded
characters.silent: tall (2.3 m) gaunt humanoid with a smooth, featureless, matte paper-white head and face (no eyes, no nose), a single thin vertical teal seam where a mouth would be. Long arms and long thin fingers like unbound pages. Tattered, faded grey-teal remnants of human clothing, ink-teal drips from the fingertips, body edges dissolving into cold teal shadow
characters.keeper: man of indeterminate age, seen only from the nose down: pale thin face, calm small smile, ink-stained fingertips. Long ink-black robe with a high deep hood that hides the eyes, sleeves embroidered with fine ochre thread script, a brass quill pen tucked in the sleeve
characters.system: a floating rectangular panel of aged cream paper with soft torn edges, a thin double border in vermilion, small notched corners, blank inside (text added later), a faint round ink-stamp seal in the bottom-right corner, slightly tilted 2-3 degrees, casting a soft shadow on the scene; no avatar, no face, never blue, never neon

locations.office-night: open-plan engineering office at 2 AM, empty. Cold fluorescent grey-green light from the ceiling, warm sodium-orange glow of city lights through the big window, a single glowing monitor with blueprint drawings, rolled drawings, a cold coffee mug, cluttered desk; lonely, slightly sickly light
locations.tower-exterior: a colossal bone-white limestone tower rising through cream clouds beyond the frame, spiral balconies, thousands of tiny vermilion glowing glyph-shaped sparks drifting upward like lanterns, empty stone plaza at dusk, sky dusty apricot at the horizon to grey-teal above
locations.corridor: narrow stone corridor, soot-dark brown walls with torn paper pages glued on them, occasional vermilion lantern-words dripping a little light, cold teal darkness at the far end
locations.room: tiny round safe room, ochre walls scratched all over with names, an old mattress and rusty tin cans, a bare lamp hanging from the ceiling whose flame has a vermilion core; warm ochre light, cosy and fragile
locations.hall: a vast colonnade hall of pale stone pillars, dim ash-grey light from high slits, Silent figures standing along the walls with blank faces turned toward the sound, a worn fresco of two girls holding hands near the exit arch
locations.s1e04:hall: huge round library, shelves from floor to a domed ceiling, thousands of glass jars each holding a glowing vermilion word like fireflies, warm amber light, paper-strewn floor, a high-backed dark wooden chair in the centre; behind the chair a sealed door covered with vermilion wax seals
locations.gate: colossal house-high stone arch with no handle or lock, one long line of faint engraved vermilion glyphs above it, cold teal shadows pooling at the base
locations.dungeon: cold bare stone hall with a high black wooden door at the far end, iron bands on the door, teal shadow, ash-grey light
locations.flash: pure white overexposed frame with a faint vermilion crack of light
locations.black: almost entirely black frame, deep ink darkness with only a faint rim light
locations.sky: open sky above the Tower, cream clouds, dusty apricot light fading to grey-teal
